g1|variants|listing and exclusion.family_title: Product Listing and Exclusion Family in SAP S/4HANA OTC
g1|variants|listing and exclusion.summary: Product listing and exclusion controls which materials a customer is allowed to buy or is strictly blocked from purchasing during sales order entry. The variants differ by whether the system performs an inclusion check (listing) or an exclusion check (exclusion), and whether the master data is maintained as condition records or via customer/material assortments.

variants.name: Standard Product Listing (Inclusion)
variants.when_used: When specific customers are restricted to purchase only an approved subset of products.
variants.key_config: Define listing procedure, assign to sales document type, and maintain condition records via VB01.

variants.name: Standard Product Exclusion
variants.when_used: When specific customers are strictly prohibited from ordering certain dangerous or restricted products.
variants.key_config: Define exclusion procedure, assign to sales document type, and maintain exclusion records via VB51.

variants.name: Listing via Product Proposal / Assortment
variants.when_used: Retail or wholesale scenarios where customer assortments dynamically drive material availability.
variants.key_config: Configure retail assortment modules, link to customer hierarchy, and activate listing check in sales area.

variants.name: Exclusion via Material Status Check
variants.when_used: Blocking discontinued or blocked-for-sale materials from being added to any sales order.
variants.key_config: Maintain material status in material master (MM02) and configure sales status checks in SD control.

g1|core|listing and exclusion|standard p.title: Standard Product Listing (Inclusion)
g1|core|listing and exclusion|standard p.story: Just like a VIP club only lets in people with a special golden ticket, this feature makes sure customers can only order specific products that are allowed for them. In technical terms, the system evaluates condition technique during sales document entry to check whether a material is allowed for a customer based on validity periods and customer-material relationships.
g1|core|listing and exclusion|standard p.why_business_needs_it: This setup prevents costly fulfillment errors and contract breaches by automatically blocking unauthorized items from being ordered by specific customers. It enforces commercial agreements, regional product restrictions, and promotional assortments directly at order entry.

g1|core|listing and exclusion|standard p.title: Standard Product Exclusion
g1|core|listing and exclusion|standard p.story: Imagine a store owner who blocks specific candy bars from being sold to a certain customer because of an allergy warning, ensuring the cash register automatically stops the cashier from ringing them up. In SAP S/4HANA Sales and Distribution (SD), Product Exclusion prevents unauthorized or restricted materials from being ordered by specific customers or distribution channels during order entry. When a sales employee attempts to add an excluded material to a sales order, the system intercepts the entry and triggers a hard rejection or warning based on condition technique configurations. This ensures compliance with regional regulations, contract agreements, or stock allocation restrictions before orders reach outbound delivery and billing.
g1|core|listing and exclusion|standard p.why_business_needs_it: The business enforces product exclusion to prevent legal liabilities, avoid costly order cancellations due to embargoed or restricted items, and automate compliance with contractual agreements. Without this automated control, customer service representatives could inadvertently accept orders for restricted items, leading to manual rework, delivery blocks, and customer dissatisfaction.

modules.role: Evaluates condition records during sales order creation to identify and reject excluded materials based on access sequences and exclusion procedures.
modules.hands_off_to: FI (Financial Accounting) and MM (Materials Management) via downstream document blocks where applicable, preventing material reservation.

prerequisites: Organizational structure (Sales Organization, Distribution Channel, Division) must be configured -- transaction OVXI
Customer master records created with sales area data -- transaction XD01

config_steps.where: V/I4 -- SPRO > Logistics - General > Listing/Exclusion > Condition Technique for Listing/Exclusion > Maintain Condition Tables
config_steps.values: Table: 002; Description: Customer/Material; Fields: Customer, Material
config_steps.check: Run transaction SE16N, enter table name A002 (or the generated table name for 002), and verify fields KUNNR and MATNR exist.
config_steps.why: Product exclusion condition tables establish the key combination fields used to identify blocked materials for specific customers during order-to-cash entry.
config_steps.if_missing: Without condition table 002, the system cannot evaluate customer-specific material exclusions during sales order creation, resulting in unblocked unauthorized sales.

Enter 002 in the Table field and press Enter
Double-click on Customer in the field catalog on the right
Double-click on Material in the field catalog on the right
Verify that Customer and Material appear in the Selected fields box
Click Generate (Ctrl+S) and confirm the transport request prompt

config_steps.check: Review transaction V/I3 for access sequence B001 and confirm step 10 points to table 002 with exclusive indicator set.
config_steps.why: The access sequence determines the search strategy the pricing and exclusion engine uses to read condition records during sales order processing.
config_steps.if_missing: If access sequence B001 is missing, the system fails to search condition tables, rendering exclusion procedures non-functional and allowing restricted materials to be ordered.
actions: Enter /nV/I3 in the command field and press Enter
Click New Entries in the application toolbar
Enter B001 in the Access Sequence field and Standard Exclusion in the Description field
Select the newly created row for B001 and double-click Accesses in the dialog structure
Click New Entries
Enter 10 in the Step field, enter 002 in the Table field, and check the Exclusive checkbox
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to a customizing transport request
